questions.chapter: Cellular Concept, Frequency Reuse & System Capacity
questions.text: Explain the Cellular Concept and Frequency Reuse. Define Cluster Size ($N = i^2 + ij + j^2$), Co-channel Reuse Ratio ($Q = \frac{D}{R} = \sqrt{3N}$), and Signal-to-Interference Ratio ($S/I = \frac{(\sqrt{3N})^n}{i_0}$). Prove that for a 7-cell reuse pattern with path loss exponent $n = 4$ and 6 first-tier co-channel interferers, $S/I \approx 18.7\,\text{dB}$.

questions.chapter: Cellular Concept, Frequency Reuse & System Capacity
questions.text: Explain Cellular System Capacity expansion techniques: (a) Cell Splitting, (b) Cell Sectoring ($120^\circ$ and $60^\circ$ sectoring), and (c) Microcell Zone Concept. Explain Handoff Strategies (Hard handoff vs Soft handoff) and Trunking Efficiency (Erlang B vs Erlang C formulas).

Explain Free Space Path Loss (Friis Transmission Equation $P_r = P_t G_t G_r \left(\frac{\lambda}{4\pi d}\right)^2$). Explain Ground Reflection (2-Ray Model) and prove that received power falls off with the fourth power of distance: $P_r \approx P_t G_t G_r \frac{h_t^2 h_r^2}{d^4}$.

Explain Small-Scale Fading mechanisms (Multipath time delay spread, Doppler spread). Differentiate between: (a) Flat Fading vs Frequency Selective Fading (Coherence Bandwidth $B_c \approx \frac{1}{5\sigma_\tau}$), and (b) Fast Fading vs Slow Fading (Coherence Time $T_c \approx \frac{9}{16\pi f_m}$). Explain Rayleigh Fading and Rician Fading distributions.

Explain Digital Modulation schemes for mobile communications: Minimum Shift Keying (MSK), Gaussian MSK (GMSK) in GSM, and Quadrature Amplitude Modulation (16-QAM, 64-QAM). Why is constant-envelope modulation favored for power-efficient non-linear RF power amplifiers?

Explain Diversity Techniques to combat multipath fading: (a) Space / Antenna Diversity, (b) Frequency Diversity, and (c) Time Diversity. Compare Combining Techniques: Selection Combining (SC), Equal Gain Combining (EGC), and Maximal Ratio Combining (MRC).

questions.chapter: Multiple Access Techniques (FDMA, TDMA, CDMA, OFDMA)
questions.text: Compare FDMA, TDMA, and CDMA multiple access schemes. Explain Direct Sequence Spread Spectrum (DSSS) and Code Division Multiple Access (CDMA). Explain Walsh orthogonal codes, PN spreading codes, Processing Gain ($PG = 10\log_{10}\frac{W}{R}$), Near-Far Problem, and Fast Closed-Loop Power Control in CDMA.

questions.chapter: Multiple Access Techniques (FDMA, TDMA, CDMA, OFDMA)
questions.text: Explain Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) and OFDMA used in 4G LTE and 5G NR. How does the Cyclic Prefix (CP) eliminate Inter-Symbol Interference (ISI) and Inter-Carrier Interference (ICI)?

Draw the complete GSM Network Architecture: Mobile Station (MS), Base Station Subsystem (BSS: BTS, BSC), Network and Switching Subsystem (NSS: MSC, HLR, VLR, AUC, EIR), and Operation Subsystem (OSS). Explain GSM frame hierarchy and call setup procedure.
Explain the key architectural enhancements in 4G LTE (E-UTRAN and Evolved Packet Core - EPC) and 5G New Radio (eMBB, URLLC, mMTC, Massive MIMO, Beamforming, and Network Slicing).
